projects.title: Lagos Coastal Inundation & Drainage Catchment Analysis
projects.summary: Integrated radar satellite imagery (Sentinel-1 SAR) with digital terrain data to identify natural drainage corridors and storm surge flood-prone areas across coastal Lagos.
projects.description: Evaluated historical flood events and topographic depressions across the Lekki peninsula and Lagos Island. The analysis mapped low-lying terrain susceptible to tidal surges, evaluated drainage flow lines, and provided spatial shapefiles for infrastructure planning.
deliverables: Inundation Hazard Maps & Drainage Corridors (GeoPackage / Shapefile)

projects.title: Multispectral Vegetation Index (NDVI) Crop Health Mapping
projects.summary: Time-series Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery analysis mapping vegetation vigor indices (NDVI) across farmland blocks to track crop development and localized growth anomalies.
projects.description: Processed cloud-filtered Sentinel-2 optical imagery to compute Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) values across active planting seasons. Identified zones of uneven canopy density to assist farm managers in targeted soil sampling and irrigation planning.

projects.title: Metropolitan Land Cover & Urban Expansion Mapping
projects.summary: Multi-temporal satellite imagery classification comparing urban built-up footprint and green space changes across the Greater Lagos metropolitan area over the past decade.
projects.description: Conducted satellite land use and land cover (LULC) classification across historic and recent Sentinel-2 and Landsat archives. Mapped built-up surface expansion, mangrove wetland boundaries, and surface water extent to aid long-term municipal planning.
deliverables: Urban Built-up vs Wetland Vector Boundaries

projects.title: Regional Solar Farm Site Suitability & Terrain Screening
projects.summary: GIS multi-criteria terrain slope analysis and proximity screening to evaluate candidate parcels for utility-scale photovoltaic solar installation.
projects.description: Combined elevation slope models, solar irradiation datasets, and proximity to existing road and transmission corridors to rank candidate development parcels across Northern Nigeria.

reviews.author: Engr. Babatunde Adeleke
reviews.content: gsVista delivered clear drainage catchment mapping and low-lying flood zone delineations for our site assessment. The spatial data was well structured and directly compatible with our engineering CAD and GIS workflow.

reviews.author: Dr. Miriam O. Nwosu
reviews.content: The NDVI vegetation index maps provided reliable visibility into crop health variability across our trial farms. gsVista was prompt, technically sound, and communicative throughout the project.
